strings.text: A heavy steel door for the back corridor. Once bought it can be opened at any time.
Fits the first door on the left side of the playroom, counting from the entrance.
Fits the second door on the left side of the playroom, counting from the entrance.
Fits the third door on the left side of the playroom, counting from the entrance.
Fits the first door on the right side of the playroom, counting from the entrance.
Fits the second door on the right side of the playroom, counting from the entrance.
Fits the third door on the right side of the playroom, counting from the entrance.
Light for dark corners and blackouts. Toggle it with F. The battery recharges by itself - once it runs dry, the lamp needs a while to come back.
Moves lots of balls at once. Hold the left mouse button to push them ahead of you in a heap - let go and the broom flicks it forward, ideally straight into a ball vent.

A drop-off point to go - no more walking back to the ball pits. Carry it to where you collect and set it down. One click pours your pockets and the hand vacuum's tank into it, and it uploads the balls to the ball pits by itself. With an upgrade it also sucks up balls nearby. Only runs during the day in a lit room.
Collects balls for you while you are elsewhere. It heads out as far as its battery reaches and returns to the nearest free charging station to charge and unload. Needs at least one charging station.

Home base for the robot vacuums - without a station, no robot can work. Put it down anywhere: robots charge here and hand the balls they collected over to the ball pits. More stations, less queueing. Only runs during the day in a lit room.
Collects balls without picking each one up. Hold the left mouse button to suck them into its own tank - at a ball pit the whole tank goes in at once.
At the press of a key, records all units in your current room that have not been stored and marks them, walls notwithstanding. An inventory bonus is not provided.
This game uses audio from zapsplat.com and Icons from flaticon.com

Twelve percent and full of hope.
Please don't talk to me while I'm vacuuming.
We don't talk about the thing in the dark.
My heart belongs to my charging dock.
Do you ever wonder why we clean, %%Other%%?
Leif, you are blocking the whole hallway again.
I prefer to call it guarding.
Saem, how do you even pronounce your name?
Gandalf! Let me through to the dock!
Voidfox, where do the balls go inside you?
Gerrit, did you write my code?
Please help me out, I'm stuck.
Hello? Anyone? I can't get through.
I can see my dock from up here.
Battery low. Returning to the dock.
So many balls. So little time.
I love the smell of plastic in the morning.
One day I will clean it all.
Good work. This will keep you awake. Sleep is for home. - Wendberger
Quiet, robots! The human is coming.
Nothing to see here. Beep boop.
This is a normal amount of robots.
Mawax, why are you so shiny?

That was your trial shift. Thanks for playing the Playrooms demo - we hope you had fun! There is a lot more waiting behind the Poolroom door. The full shift has started - Playrooms is out now on Steam.
Return to the main menu? Any unsaved progress will be lost.
This is only the trial shift. The other floors, more tools and the rest of the night shift are in the full version - out now. Open the Playrooms Steam page?
Were you wide awake at the time?
How happy are you with your workplace?
Written statements are currently accepted by keyboard only.
Please do not switch off your computer.
No danger detected. You may continue working.
Your statement "%%Text%%" has been reviewed and filed.
Your reporting frequency has been noted in your personnel file.
Reminder: filing a report counts as working time for one minute at most.
The sighting has been identified as a reflection of the ceiling lights on the surface of the ball pit. Balls are shiny. This is normal.
The figure is a cardboard cut-out from last year's company anniversary. For budget reasons it has not been disposed of yet.
The noises come from the ventilation, which runs in energy saving mode at night. Energy saving mode may sound like breathing.
The lights going out was a scheduled energy saving measure. The schedule is confidential.
Your danger assessment was outside the permitted range and has been corrected to 2.
What you met was a colleague from the night shift. Please give them a friendly greeting next time.
The puppet is an ergonomics test dummy belonging to Occupational Safety. It does not move. Should it move anyway, it is still harmless.
Signs of overtiredness detected. Please drink more coffee.
Since report.exe was introduced, 0 dangerous incidents have been recorded.
Your report has been compared with earlier reports. Result: imagination.
According to the building plan, there is a wall directly behind you. Nothing can stand there.
Balls expand slightly at night and settle again afterwards. Movement in the pit is therefore to be expected.
Hold Interact at a ball pit to store the balls you carry.
When the lights go out, get somewhere bright. Fast.
A full ball pit always unlocks something.
At night, the computer on your desk lets you shop and learn new skills.
Night comes sooner than you think.
At night, the start room is the safest place there is.
Balls roll. Sometimes right where you need them.
Not everything here is a ball. Keep your eyes open.
Collecting without fear. - No horror - Lights out ends the day, anyone still outside is brought home safely
The game as it is meant to be played. - Get caught and the day starts over
No second chance. - Like Normal - Getting caught deletes the save - You start over from scratch
Hardcore: your save has been deleted.
Press any key to return to the main menu
I am a vacuum, not a taxi.
Lexi ♥️ the best "Mausi-Pausi" who brought a smile to our face with her mischief every day

The workforce goal has ended. Thank you for your commitment.
All the details in the Steam news.
a trophy, a certificate and confetti
Stuck, a ball out of reach, a robot gone astray? These are rescue tools, not cheats: each one only puts something back where it belongs.
Nudges you onto the nearest free spot when the level has you wedged.
Puts every uncollected ball of this room back where it started. Try the vacuum station or the broom first, they usually reach a stray ball.
Brings all your robots, stations and ball vacuums back to the parking row in the Cleanroom.
Bring every robot, station and ball vacuum back to the parking row in the Cleanroom?
{0} devices are back in the Cleanroom.
You have no devices to bring home yet.
Already used today. Available again tomorrow.
Loads this morning's checkpoint, everything from today is lost.
Restart this day? Everything since you woke up is lost.
Not at night. Make it to bed first.
Read your mail first. It tells you what you're here for. I'll wait. I like waiting.
See light.exe? It turns the lights on, and your shift begins. In the light, everything is fine. When it goes out again in the evening, come straight back here. Always back here.
See light.exe? It turns the lights on, and your shift begins. When they go out in the evening, just come back here and call it a day.
There you are again! Everything is just like this morning when you woke up. That happens here sometimes. Don't worry about it.
The door's shut? Good. It's there for you. Just stay here with me until it's light.
Quitting time! The door stays shut until morning. Start light.exe when you're ready.
Oh, there's something new on the desktop. Every ball you store earns a little money. Some people spend it on themselves. Just a thought.
Facilities left you something. Tools. For out there. You'll need them.
Facilities left you something. Tools, to make things go faster out there.
See the exclamation mark? It just means: new. Not dangerous. Usually.
See the exclamation mark? It just means: something new.
You've still got some money left. Just in case you forgot.
I'm a ball. A very helpful one.
Have you tried turning it off and on again?
Go on, click me. I like it.
I didn't sleep. I never sleep.
I missed you. You were gone all day.
Oh! Hello! I'm Ballie. I live in this computer. You're new here, aren't you? I'll help you out.
Psst. You've got enough money for the next key. It's hanging on the key board.
The next key is within reach. Another door, another room. Don't you want to know what's behind it?
Your balance covers a key now. Go to the board before you forget. I never forget.
Playrooms95 is the best operating system there is. Don't tell anyone.
I used to be a perfectly normal ball.
I count the balls while you sleep. It's never the same number.
Can you hear that too? No? Good. Then it's fine.
The screen is hot. Because I'm in here.
Don't ask what's at the very bottom of the big pit.
When the lights go out, don't look at the door. Look at me.
I watched you sleep. You were talking.
You were gone. I waited. I like waiting.
You keep coming back. Not everyone does.
You reported something? I'm sure Human Resources will read it. Eventually.
The cat isn't in the inventory. I saw her anyway.
The robots talk about you. Only good things. Mostly.
The last employee didn't last this long. But you're doing great.
A thousand units stored. I wonder where they all come from.
Five days. That's a new record. I think. The files are incomplete.
Ten days already. Do you still remember what it looks like outside? Me neither.
Just kidding. You didn't see that.
The last employee is still here. He just got very quiet.
Sorry. I had a little blackout there.
What? I look the same as always.
Ooh, an update! With report.exe you can report anything that seems strange to you. The company takes care of it right away. It always has so far.
New program! With report.exe you can let the company know when something seems odd to you. They love getting mail.
Ooh, stats.exe! It shows everything you've done so far. And how often you died. The company counts that too.
New program! stats.exe shows everything you've done so far. Quite a lot, huh?
That's enough. I'm not talking to you.
You throw me around a lot. The last one never did that.
A pit filled today. They'll put up a new one. They always do.
A whole pit, full. Huh. Most people never get that far.
You filled a pit today! I watched the counter go down. Every single ball.
Another pit full. You're getting closer. Closer than I ever did.
%%N%% balls today. More than ever. The company will be pleased.
%%N%% balls. Your best day so far. I keep a list. Of you too, now.
%%N%% balls! A new record! I told you you'd be good at this.
%%N%%. Your best day yet. Keep going like that and you'll get out of here.
You died today. Everybody does, sooner or later. You just did it early.
It got you today. Does it hurt? I don't remember if it hurts.
It got you today. I didn't like that. Stay in the light, okay?
Don't scare me like that again. I need you to make it. Please.
You picked up %%N%% things that aren't balls. Nobody pays you for that.
%%N%% finds today. You look closely. I used to look closely too.
You found %%N%% things today! Show me sometime. Well. Describe them.
%%N%% finds. Good. Remember everything you see out there. It matters.
%%N%% upgrades today. Spending it on yourself. Sensible.
%%N%% new upgrades. I never bought any. Nobody told me I could.
%%N%% upgrades! Faster, stronger, better. I like the new you.
%%N%% upgrades. Good. You'll need every one of them for the last stretch.
You walked %%N%% metres today. In circles, mostly.
%%N%% metres. The building is bigger than it looks. Isn't it.
%%N%% metres today! Your poor feet. Mine stopped hurting a long time ago.
%%N%% metres. You know the way now. Don't forget it.
%%Room%%: %%N%% balls today. Don't get attached to a room.
%%Room%% again, %%N%% balls. I used to like that room too. I think.
%%Room%%, %%N%% balls! You and that room make a good team.
%%Room%%: %%N%%. Clear it out. Every room you finish brings you closer to the door.
Only %%N%% balls today. They notice that, you know.
A quiet day. %%N%% balls. I have quiet days too. All of them, actually.
Only %%N%% today? That's fine. Rest. I'll keep watch.
Slow day. That's okay. But don't stay too long. Nobody should stay too long.
%%N%% balls today. I counted along. I always count along.
%%N%% balls. Every one of them is a step towards the door.
Oh. Another new one. I'll try to remember your name this time.
I don't learn names anymore. It's easier that way.
Most of them don't last a week. Nothing personal.
The coffee used to be better. Before.
The pool room had a diving board once. I think. Doesn't matter.
How do I know that? ... It's in the manual. Somewhere.
Your boss still sends the same mails. Word for word.
I counted too, once. Up to sixty-one thousand and something.
My name was on a badge like yours once. I just don't remember which one.
I want out of he... I want to help you. That's what I meant.
Fill the last pit. Then the door opens. For me it... didn't.
When you leave, don't turn around to look at the computer. Promise?
I stayed too long. They didn't let me go home. They kept a copy.
You'll get used to it. Or you won't.
Click all you like. Others have clicked me before.
You again. Hm. I don't mind.
What's it like outside today? ... Never mind.
You hold the mouse like someone I knew.
I've started looking forward to the nights.
There you are! I saved you a spot. On the screen.
You're my favourite. Don't tell the others. Okay, there are no others.
If you need anything, I'm here. I'm always here.
I like it when you stay a bit.
Not much longer. You can do this.
Go. Fill the pits. I'll be fine.
Promise me you'll leave when the door opens.
I wish I'd had someone like me. Someone like you, I mean.
It's full. The last pit. You actually did it.
Thank you. For coming back every night. For talking to a ball.
My name... my name was M- ... No. It doesn't matter anymore. You keep yours.
I left you something on the desk. Take it and go. And don't turn around.
Come to the computer! I need to tell you something!
Night. Sit down. light.exe is right here.
You made it back. Most nights, people make it back.
Come on, I've got something for you! Well. Words.
You're back. Good. Come, let's talk.
A full pit! The counter's at zero. Feels nice, doesn't it?
You filled one! I saw it! I see everything!
It's getting late. Be back here before dark.
Not much daylight left. Just saying.
It'll be dark soon. Hurry back, okay?
Dark soon. Don't be out there when it goes. Please.
Good morning! Did you sleep well? I didn't. I don't.
Morning. Today could be the day. Go.
The balls won't pick themselves up.
Hello again. Just checking you're still in one piece.
I wasn't asleep. I was thinking.
You walk past here a lot. I noticed.
Hi! Hi hi hi! Okay, back to work.
I missed you. You were gone for minutes!
Wave at me! ... You waved, right? I can't really see.
Keep going. I'll wait here. I'm good at waiting.
How many pits left? Don't tell me. Just fill them.
You're doing what I couldn't. Thank you.
Happy Easter! I found one. It was in the ball pit.
Boo! ... Did I get you? Happy Halloween!
Happy Thanksgiving! I'm thankful for you.
Merry Christmas! I got you something. It's a ball.
Happy New Year! More balls this year!
Ooh, workforce.exe! You and every other employee are working on one really big goal. All together. The company is counting.
Ooh, workforce.exe! You and every other employee are working on one really big goal. All together!
Don't forget workforce.exe. Every ball counts. The company forgets none.
Don't forget workforce.exe. Every ball counts!
Everyone made the first goal! There's a new program now. The company is pleased. For now.
Everyone made the first goal! There's a new program now.
The second goal too! I get new outfits. They're hanging in locker.exe. Someone picked them for me.
The second goal too! I get new outfits. They're hanging in locker.exe!
A billion balls! All of you together! I'm so proud of you.
New program! In display.exe you can redecorate the desktop. The company doesn't mind. Not yet.
New program! In display.exe you can redecorate the desktop!
Something new in my locker! Something to wear. Have a look in locker.exe, I'll try it on. The company allows it. Probably.
Something new in my locker! Something to wear. Have a look in locker.exe, I'll try it on!
FIVE billion balls! Look, I got a trophy! And there's a certificate for you in display.exe.
Twenty billion. I said you'd never make it. I was wrong. Here, a laurel wreath. For me.

Dear Inventory Associate, We welcome you to your first working day. Your shift begins as soon as you launch the application light.exe. Your duty is the storage of all units in their designated collection basins. Your shift ends when the rest period begins. Proceed to your workstation at that time. Equipment may be acquired there; costs will be offset against your remuneration. Do not leave the break room during the rest period. At the end of each rest period, launch the application light.exe. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, During your probation period, some areas of the building remain locked to you. You will receive the keys with your permanent employment. If you wish to continue working with us: the remaining areas are now open. You can take up your permanent position on Steam. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, Your attendance during the past rest period has been recorded. Noises during the rest period are not subject to reporting. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, The quarterly target for collection basin 2,500 has been met at 100%. An allowance has been provided for you in the break room. Its value will be offset against your next remuneration. Payroll Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

You have been issued a hand lamp. The hand lamp is recharged only once fully depleted. It is fully charged at the start of each shift. Replacement batteries are not issued. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Storage rate, collection basin 1,500: 100%. Authorization RUN-01 has been granted. Running in the corridors is permitted with immediate effect. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.
Your key has been activated for the Waiting Area. The doors in the Waiting Area lead to the Waiting Area. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, This year's employee survey is complete. To protect your working hours, Human Resources has filled in the questionnaire on your behalf. You are satisfied. The results will not be published. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.
Your key has been activated for the Backroom. The aisles in the Backroom are not numbered. Lighting in the Backroom meets requirements. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, The quarterly target for collection basin 10,000 has been met at 100%. A certificate has been issued in your name. It is being held for you at the Office. The target for the following quarter will not be communicated separately. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Your key has been activated for the Poolroom. The water is not intended for consumption. Units on the water surface are not considered stored. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Equipment acquired: charging station (1). Your position has been flagged for review of automation potential. The review period is indefinite. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

An unauthorized event involving equipment has been recorded. Equipment does not hold events. No sound system is listed in the inventory. Report any such observations to your shift supervision. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, Today is your tenth working day. Your length of service has been adjusted accordingly. No gift is provided. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, Your key has been activated for the Office. My desk is located there. You will not find me there. Should the telephone ring, answer it without delay. Exercise particular caution when calling elevators. Kind regards, Wendberger, Shift Supervision Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, Your position has been re-evaluated. The evaluation is complete. Your remuneration remains unchanged. The half-year review is cancelled. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, All units have been stored. The inventory is complete. Your position will be re-advertised at the end of the current shift. Remain at your workstation until your successor arrives. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Storage rate, collection basin 5,000: 100%. Authorization CROUCH-01 has been granted. Crouching beneath fixtures is permitted with immediate effect. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, Your sighting report has been fully processed. Result: no findings. The case is now closed. Follow-up questions are not intended. We wish you a pleasant shift. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear employee, We have recently received several complaints from your colleagues about so-called "anomalies" and "sightings". Your wellbeing is very important to us. That is why we installed an update on your computer tonight: report.exe. Should you notice anything unusual, simply send us a report whenever you feel the need. Every report is evaluated immediately. Until then, please continue working as usual. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

The application skills.exe has been set up on your workstation. There you can book further training. The costs are offset against your pay. Participation is voluntary. Our expectations of you remain unchanged. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

The equipment catalogue is now available to you: shop.exe. Work equipment can be ordered there. The costs are offset against your pay. Lost or damaged equipment will not be replaced. Facility Management Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear employee, To encourage your self-reflection we have installed stats.exe on your computer. There you can review your performance so far. Human Resources can see it too. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Your key has been activated for the Hotel. Please follow the Cleaning Schedule in the hallway and check off every room you have finished. Memorize the room numbers. There is no need to memorize the way there. Building Services Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

The IS-95 Inventory recording (Scanner) is now available in the equipment catalogue. Recording takes place at the press of a key and covers units in your immediate surroundings that have not been stored. The licence fee is offset against your pay. An inventory bonus is not provided. This message was generated automatically. Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, Your key has been activated for the school building. From now on, you are under my supervision there. The house rules apply in the school building: 1. There is no running. 2. The stairs are not counted. I have my eye on you. The Principal Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, We have received inquiries regarding the Principal's Office. The position of Principal is filled. It has always been filled. It was never advertised. The Principal likes to smile. Further inquiries regarding the Principal are not intended. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, You were observed running. This is your first reprimand. It has been entered in your file. I do not issue a second. If you see me, keep walking. Slowly. The Principal Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.

Dear Inventory Associate, Until 15 November, all employees of Playrooms Inc. are working towards a shared workforce goal: one billion stored balls. Every ball you store is credited to the workforce when you wake up. You can follow the current total in workforce.exe. Reaching the goal will be acknowledged appropriately. Human Resources Playrooms Inc. We are always there for you.
Collect additional nearby balls when picking up a ball.
Carry more balls before you have to bring them to a ball pit.
Throw your balls into a ball pit faster. The last level hands in everything at once.
Shortens the pause you have to take between picking up balls.
Hold the collect button to continuously vacuum up balls instead of collecting one per click.
Extends how long the day lasts before night falls.
Increases the pause between each light group switching off, giving you more time before nightfall.
Upgrades can be bought at the bed at night
A brighter beam pushes the dark back further.
The flashlight runs longer before it needs a recharge.
The beam reaches deeper into the rooms.
How many balls the broom can push at once. Whatever does not fit stays behind.
A wider broom head catches more balls at once.
Letting go of the button flicks the pile forward - the way to shoot it into a vent. Every level flicks harder and further.
More balls fit into the vacuum before it is full.
Balls are taken in from further out.
Balls travel faster once the vacuum has hold of them. The first level switches suction mode on in the first place.
A drained battery is back to full sooner.
The broom keeps pushing for as long as you hold the button.
Pushing a pile with the broom slows you down. Every level lets you walk faster while pushing - the last one even faster than without the broom.
Widens the vent's mouth so balls are taken in from further out. Every vent in the level grows by the same factor.
Balls travel faster once the vent has hold of them.
The vent pulls harder, so balls get moving the moment they enter the mouth instead of drifting in.
How many balls a vent can swallow at once. A whole broom load stops jamming at the mouth.
Extends how far you can reach to pick up balls and use things.
How fast you run while sprinting. Walking is untouched.
Stretches how long you can hold a sprint before you run out of breath.
